# sd a b c d tx ty SEGS => SEGS   (applyMatrixToStrokeData on a segment stroke) ; rr a b c d tx ty X Y W H OP => X Y W H OP   (the isRaster branch)
# bc CW CH LIST => X Y   (_boundsCenterOfStrokes with state.canvasW/H = CW/CH)
